Why you should uncrust your crusty dog! 🫣 Leaving too much buildup on your dog for too long can cause irritation and discomfort for your pet. The best way to prevent this is with regular grooming, keeping the eyes clean and cleared, cleaning around the eyes daily with pet friendly eye wipes, and finding the source of the irritant. It’s also beneficial to look into things that support healthy tear production like filtered water and supplements. Always make sure to use a gentle facial cleanser to avoid irritating their eyes and face. A Golden Retriever is a popular and friendly dog breed. It is known for its beautiful golden coat, kind personality, and intelligence. Golden Retrievers are loyal, gentle, and very playful. They love spending time with people and are great with children, so they make wonderful family pets. They are also easy to train because they learn quickly and enjoy working with their owners. Golden Retrievers need regular exercise, such as walking, running, and playing fetch. They also love swimming because they are natural water dogs. Thanks to their calm and caring nature, they are often used as guide dogs, therapy dogs, and rescue dogs.
